primary_source.title: Geographic barriers but not life history traits shape the phylogeography of North American mammals

biological_response: Actual manually mapped within-species phylogeographic break LINE LOCATION, not Fst magnitude, expected heterozygosity or interspecific contact zone
first_gate: Confirm source files are truly downloadable and have native geometry with species ID, era metadata and sampled-range masks OR provided background points. If not, NOT_EVALUABLE, do not replace with paper figures or guessing.

preresponse_qualification.negative_spatial_control: Within original author's sampled portion of each species geographic range; never treat unsurveyed portions as confirmed negative
preresponse_qualification.max_allowed_label_uncertainty: Study used manual interpretation, nominal 50 km jitter as sensitivity; retain as uncertainty not exact break
preresponse_qualification.spatial_bias: Separate same-species within-range case/background; required source and geographic support audit
preresponse_qualification.disallow: training case/background across random points of same species; no taxonomic leakage, no point-wise pseudo-independent inferential SE

preregistered_main_test.historical_focal: Local 21ka-to-0BP climatic-change magnitude sampled at candidate break and background sites (CHELSA-TraCE21k V1.0 bio01, bio07, bio12, bio15), standardized using training species within-range background values only
preregistered_main_test.estimator: Within each species, compare held-out break-vs-background AUC using source author's baseline geography with/without one predefined historical magnitude term
preregistered_main_test.split: SHA256('ttf-jensen-na-mammal-break-v01|'+lowercase accepted Latin binomial) first digest byte parity; all breaks and spatial background points for species same role
preregistered_main_test.weighting: Equal species weight, spatial clustering by species for uncertainty; avoid treating 10 km points on a line as independent replication
preregistered_main_test.scoring: Species-balanced held-out AUC gain. Spatial uncertainty tested with predetermined jitter only if full field data available. Positive claim only if bootstrap species 95% lower >0.
preregistered_main_test.limitation: Climate LGM 21 ka versus modern is not dated genetic-break origin; 2024 linework includes manually interpolated break positions; predictor can encode geographic latitudinal gradients.

warning: This is a new analysis plan only. Biological labels are NOT opened until source, geometry, and comparable negatives are checked.
